section_summary.extract_value: This Discussion summarizes a single study that tested a sociocultural model linking overheard family 'fat talk' to mindful eating via positive body image variables. Results (in a college female sample) showed that overhearing family body criticism was associated with lower mindful eating and body appreciation, with body functionality appreciation partially mediating the link to mindful eating. No other studies or sample subsets (e.g., Study 1, Study 2) are mentioned.
